seen.where: BYU L. Tom Perry Special Collections, Vault MSS 771 (ArchiveGrid 122536438; BYU Sfondrati collection page lib.byu.edu/collections/sfondrati-family-papers/)
seen.extent: 27 letters of 1583, mostly Carlo d'Aragona Tagliavia (governor of Milan) to Paolo Sfondrati and to the future Gregory XIV
seen.cipher: Finding aid quoted in the lead: "handwritten letters on paper, many of which are partially or entirely in code". BYU's public Sfondrati page covers MSS 524 (legal and land papers 1494-1900) and does not mention MSS 771 or any code; no image of these letters was reached (ArchiveGrid returned 403, BYU archives search 403).
